Maintainer.Profile: Developer of Quire Ink, a self-hosted blog platform in one container: a real editor over Markdown, newsletters over your own SMTP, comments, cookie-free analytics, importers for WordPress/Ghost/Substack/Medium, eleven interface languages, and no third-party requests anywhere. This repository holds the official Unraid templates. The templates are MIT; the application itself is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial, with unmodified releases free to run commercially).
